lenders.why: Aave looks at the bitcoin alone, not the hedge: against $100,577 of it, it lends $56,994 at 4.97% a year, and sells if bitcoin falls 33.3%. Our pool lends the other $23,783 at 6.50%. Moving that bitcoin to Ethereum and back costs $654 ($432 there, $221 back), and Aave's lower rate saves $215 over 90 days, which doesn't cover it, so Aave isn't used: our pool lends the whole $80,777.

Rhea looks at the bitcoin alone, not the hedge: against $100,577 of it, it lends $50,959 at 16.08% a year, and sells if bitcoin falls 33.3%. Our pool lends the other $29,818 at 6.50%. Rhea costs more than our pool, so it isn't used: our pool lends the whole $80,777.
